name: Galileo 2 G2E
description: The Galileo 2 G2E (Galileo 2 Extruder) is designed as a drop-in replacement for the Clockwork 2 (CW2) extruder on the Voron StealthBurner toolhead. It uses a custom-designed 9:1 planetary gear system with dual drive gears, offering high torque and smooth extrusion free of gear-meshing noise. The design was created and open-sourced by JaredC01.
features: Drop-in replacement for Clockwork 2 in Voron StealthBurner
Same planetary gear internals as Galileo 2 SA
Compatible with all current Stealthburner toolhead boards
